blocks.text: Energy of a body is its capacity to do work. There are two basic forms of energy:

blocks.title: Kinetic and potential energy
blocks.text: Kinetic energy is the energy possessed by a body due to its motion and potential energy is the energy possessed by a body due to its changed position.
The kinetic energy and the potential energy both are the kinds of mechanical energy.
